title: Home guide: the scratch test for hardness
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Making materials (9E); conservation of energy
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 17 (Home practical guide and safety card: scratch test (portal worksheet; no knives or broken glass))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

equipment: A copper coin and a steel key
Soap, chalk, a candle, a tile, a plastic lid
A magnifying glass if you have one
safety: Scratch gently, away from your body
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Try to scratch each material with your fingernail.
If there is no mark, try the coin; then the steel key.
Record which tool first leaves a mark.
Rank the materials from softest to hardest.
